book.name: 2 Korina
book.title: KORINA TANGE DUPANYA POLOME PEPA PYAO PYASAKAMAIYAMO LAPO PYOO DOKO

content: Nambame nyakama dee mona kenda pisala naeyatoo latala, nyakama kateamino dokonya naipatoo lao masio.
Nambame nyakamanya mona kenda pisakato doko, apitupame nambanya mona auu pisakatami? Nambame mona kenda pisakamaito endakali dupameaka nambanya mona auu pisakatami.

Namba nyakama kalyamino dokonya ipato dokopa, nambanya mona auu pisakapenge endakali dupame namba mona kenda pisala naeyataminopa lao, nambame pepa mende doko nyakamanya pyao peekeo. Dopa piona, namba auu kaeyapae nyoto mendai dokoaka nyakama nyetamina lao nambame kyeto joo masio.

Nambame nyakama mona kenda pisalanya pepa pyao peakala naeyo. Nyakama etete auu kaenge namba-kisa silyamo doko masalapale lao, namba kenda andakepi, monanya maka kaeyapaepi, dupanya katao, namba ee longo lao, pepa pyao peekeo.
Koo Pingiamo Doko Kame Sakamaiyepape Leamo Doko
Mona kenda pisiamo akali dokome namba iki mona kenda pisala naenya, nyakama pitaka kuki mona kenda pisiaka. (Nambame kyeto joo laa naelyo.)
Nyakamanya endakali longome baa tanda maitilyamino doko yaka.
Aopyoo latala baa etete mona kenda kaeyatana, nyakamame baanya koo dupa kame setakamai mona epe palisakamaiyepape.
Dopa petala nyakamame baa auu kaelyamanona lao, lao panalapale lao nambame kyeto joo lelyo.
Nambame pii langio dupa pitaka nyakamame kyeto joo wata-minilyamipi, wata-minala naelyamipi lao kandatoo latala, makande pyoo nambame nyakamanya pepa pyao peekeo.

Satanenya masingi koo dupa naimame kandenge dokonya, baame naima ita naminina lao, endakali mendenya koo dupa kame sakamaipenge jilyamo doko, nambame nyakama masetala, Kraisanya enombanya kame sakamaingi. Dopana, nyakamame endakali mendenya koo dupa kame sakamaitamino doko, nambame baanya koo dupa kameaka sakamaito.
Kraisa-Kisa Katao Ita Miningi Dokonya Leamo Doko
Nambame Kraisanya wai pii epe doko lamaiyanya Troasa peopa, Kamongome baanya kalai doko pyakatale lao nambanya kaitini setekea.
Dopaka doko, nambanya Kristene kaiminingi Taitusa baa kutao kaeyapala, nambanya mona doko yaina piamosa, nambame endakali dupa katena lao lasa latala Masedonia peo.

Goteme Kraisa-kisa Satane yanda pimaiyoo ita minateona lao panasoo, endakali dupanya enombanya koteaka lao baame naima laminao paenge. Wele epe tunduma pingi mende tunduma pyoo taengeli pyoo, Kraisa doko dopale-lamo lao kandao nyingi mana doko naimame endakali dupa lamaiyoo yuu pitakanya taeyalapa lao Goteme lenge. Dopa lenge dokonya, nambame Gote yaka pilyino lenge.
Endakali pyoo nyepae dupapi, kumao alu pipenge dupapi, dupanya kainanya naima tunduma pingi epe mende, Kraisame Gote kundi maingi dopale joo kalyamano.

Tunduma epe doko, kumao alu pipenge endakali dupa-kisa etete ai pyatala dokome, dupa laminao kumingi dokonya penge. Dopaka doko, tunduma epe doko, pyoo nyepae kalyamino endakali dupa-kisa tunduma epe petala dokome, dupa laminao lete katenge dokonya penge. Dopana, apimi kalai dupa kapa pao pipenge?

Endakali yangi dupame Gotenya pii dokome bisinisa pyoo muni nyalanya lamaiyoo paengema. Naima dopale daa. Goteme naima kalai doko diamo dokonya, naimame sambo nalenya, Kraisa-kisa katao wai pii epe doko Gotenya enombanya endakali dupa lamaingi.
